exceptions.justification: This package was just scaffolded and has no Socket.dev API token yet, so the SecuritySocket scan cannot run in CI. The rest of the contract runs; the supply-chain score is unchecked until a token exists.
exceptions.ruleBroken: A check that could not run fails the CI gate unless a record says why that is acceptable.
exceptions.attempted: Nothing yet: the repository secret SOCKET_SECURITY_API_KEY has not been created.
exceptions.constraint: A Socket.dev token belongs to a person or an organization and cannot be scaffolded.
exceptions.whyPreferable: A red first CI run teaches an adopter the exception schema before it teaches them the package; a dated record teaches the decision instead.
exceptions.residualRisk: Alerts on this package's dependencies are not scored until a token exists; npm audit (SecurityDeps) still runs.
exceptions.revisitWhen: A SOCKET_SECURITY_API_KEY repository secret exists (then delete this record), or this record expires.

exceptions.justification: CodeRabbit reviews pull requests as a GitHub App; its CLI is not run inside the CI contract job.
exceptions.ruleBroken: CodeRabbit findings must be addressed or recorded before merge.
exceptions.attempted: Running the CodeRabbit CLI in the workflow, which needs a CodeRabbit API key that is not issued to CI.
exceptions.constraint: In CI the review is the GitHub App's; the CLI only reviews uncommitted local edits.
exceptions.whyPreferable: The App's review threads must be resolved on the pull request before merge (the ruleset requires it), so its findings still block.
exceptions.residualRisk: A finding the App never raised is not seen; the same is true of any reviewer. Until the App is installed on this repository (owner step), no CodeRabbit review happens at all.
exceptions.revisitWhen: CodeRabbit ships a CI mode for the CLI, or the App is uninstalled.

exceptions.justification: https://maverickcer.github.io/test-cap/ is the landing page's canonical URL, which IPC's site generator takes from siteUrl. It returns 404 until this change is merged to main and the first GitHub Pages deploy publishes the site.
exceptions.attempted: Removed every other link to the unpublished site from README, GUIDE, ADOPTION and docs/site.json; these three remain because the site generator requires an https canonical URL and the landing page needs a link to the guide.
exceptions.constraint: GitHub Pages serves nothing before the first deploy from main, and the deploy runs only after this change merges.
exceptions.whyPreferable: The owner chose a short-lived record over publishing placeholder content first or shipping without the landing page (2026-11-17).
exceptions.residualRisk: If the first deploy fails, these links stay broken; the first DocsLinks run on main after the deploy reports it, and the follow-up pull request that re-adds the site links deletes these records.
exceptions.revisitWhen: The first GitHub Pages deploy from main succeeds; the follow-up pull request deletes this record.
